Fields.Name: Circuit ID
Fields.Description: Circuit/channel id for a monitoring report. In ZCF config transfers it instead carries the configuration id (write announce and module advertisement) or the ZCF file size in bytes (download announce).

Fields.Name: Measurement Value
Fields.Description: Monitoring value. During ZCF transfers it forms part of the configuration descriptor used for conflict detection; observed as 0 in config claims.

Fields.Name: Mode Flags
Fields.Description: Transfer control bits. bit0 (0x1) = sync/reset (clears the transfer sequence state); bit1 (0x2) = config-transfer advertise: a read request when the id field is 0, otherwise a write announce (tool) or download announce (module).

Fields.Name: DIP Switch
Fields.Description: CZone module DIP-switch address of the sender or target. 0xFF = broadcast / all modules.

Fields.Name: Target
Fields.Description: Echoes the DataBlock Flags byte (the write target). 0xFF = broadcast; otherwise the target module DIP-switch. The tool ignores the ACK unless this matches its current write target.

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: 0 = data block stored OK; 1 = terminator accepted / transfer complete.

Fields.Name: Configuration Block Index
Fields.Description: The PGN 130816 block index being acknowledged.

Fields.Name: Module DIP Switch
Fields.Description: DIP-switch address of the acknowledging module. Indexes the tool's per-block ACK bitmap; must match the DIP the module advertised when registering.

PGNs.Description: BEP Marine: CZone Circuit Extended State
PGNs.Explanation: CZone circuit extended state message. The message identifies the module by DIP switch, module type, and channel page, followed by 32 LSB-first circuit flags. The module type selects whether the flags describe 32, 16, or 8 channels per page and whether additional status banks are present.

Fields.Name: DIP Switch
Fields.Description: CZone module DIP-switch / module instance byte

Fields.Name: Page
Fields.Description: Field/page value, used as high page bits for the channel number

Fields.Name: Circuit Flags
Fields.Description: 32 LSB-first flags. Module types 8, 9, and 14 use a 32-channel/page direct state layout; module types 11, 16, and 17 use a 16-channel/page direct state layout; module types 28 and 31 use an 8-channel/page extended status layout; other module types use an 8-channel/page default layout.

Fields.Name: Configuration Block Index
Fields.Description: Sequential transfer block number. The corresponding ZCF file offset is usually blockIndex * 200.

Fields.Name: Target
Fields.Description: Write target / broadcast selector. The receiving module echoes this byte in the DataBlock ACK (PGN 65291) target field. 0xFF = broadcast (network write to all modules); otherwise the target module DIP-switch address.

Fields.Name: Padding
Fields.Description: 18 bytes of 0xFF padding between the 5-byte header and the file data (bytes 5..22 of the reassembled payload).

Fields.Name: ZCF File Data
Fields.Description: ZCF file fragment, up to 200 bytes; goes to file offset blockIndex * 200. A zero-length fragment marks the transfer terminator. Block 0 starts with the 6-byte ZCF header [0x06][length:u32 LE][header CRC-8] followed by the config payload; the file's final byte is the payload CRC-8 (CRC-8 poly 0x07).
